title: $π^2$: Structure-Originated Reasoning Data Improves Long-Context Reasoning Ability of Large Language Models
authors_zh: Quyet V. Do, Thinh Pham, Nguyen Nguyen, Sha Li, Pratibha Zunjare, Tu Vu
paper_type_zh: 长上下文推理数据集、生成流程与评测集
best_for_zh: 适合构造可验证多文档推理 SFT 数据的研究者。
one_line: π2 turns Wikipedia tables into long-context QA with SQL/Python-agreed answers and back-translated reasoning traces for data-efficient SFT.
π2 将 Wikipedia 表格转成由 SQL 与 Python 双路径确认答案的长上下文问答，再反向生成推理轨迹用于高效 SFT。
why: It combines realistic unstructured contexts with an executable ground-truth path and releases the resulting training records.
inclusion_reason: Provides open long-context QA and reasoning traces whose answers are grounded by independent SQL and Python execution.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Long context windows do not guarantee that a model can aggregate evidence scattered across documents and perform reliable multi-hop analysis. Existing long-context QA often lacks both realistic unstructured context and an executable path for establishing the correct answer.

π² starts from Wikipedia tables, generates analytical questions whose answers agree under independent SQL and Python execution, replaces the table with realistic web documents, and back-translates a step-by-step trace from the context and verified answer. It produces training data where ground truth comes from structure but the student must reason over ordinary long text.

L4 facts: official source arXiv:2604.05114, 2026; preprint marked under review with no confirmed acceptance; decision boundary is SQL/Python-agreed QA with retained long-context evidence; Track-01 object is context, multi-hop question, reasoning trace, and short answer; collected as an existing promoted Card.

长 context window 并不保证模型能汇总散布在多份文档中的证据并完成可靠多跳分析。已有长上下文 QA 往往既缺少真实的非结构化上下文，也缺少确定正确答案的可执行路径。

π² 从 Wikipedia 表格出发，生成 SQL 与 Python 独立执行结果一致的分析问题，再用真实网页文档替代原表格，并根据上下文和已验证答案反向生成逐步推理。这样得到的数据由结构确定 ground truth，但学生模型必须在普通长文本中完成推理。

L4 事实：官方来源为 arXiv:2604.05114，年份为 2026；预印本标注 under review，未确认接收；判定边界是 SQL 与 Python 答案一致且长上下文保留证据的 QA；Track 01 对象是上下文、多跳问题、推理轨迹与短答案组成的记录；该条目是已有并已提升的 Card。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
π² separates answer construction from reasoning-trace construction. Tables make multi-hop questions and answers executable; after verification, web pages turn the same task into realistic long-context reading, and a teacher writes a trace without seeing the hidden table. This prevents the teacher from defining its own ground truth while still producing model-compatible reasoning supervision.

Open dataset: yes. Name: π² training data and π²-Bench. Official code/project: https://github.com/vt-pi-squared/pi-squared. Official data: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1ISRgLijDFvwFpHzV4tmHix6MIwIGG2gd?usp=sharing. Scale: 1,174 validated QA traces, including 922 training records; π²-Bench contains 228 human-reviewed items split into 178 test and 50 validation examples. Record form: long unstructured context, analytical question, structured reasoning trace, short answer, and construction metadata; the repository links JSONL data. Construction uses Wikipedia tables/pages, about ten web-search articles per QA, SQL/Python consensus, quality ratings, and model-family-matched back-translation. License: not confirmed. Intended use: long-context SFT, self-distillation, and evaluation.

π² 把答案构造与推理轨迹构造分开。表格使多跳问题和答案可以执行验证；验证后，网页把同一任务变成真实长上下文阅读，教师模型在看不到隐藏表格的情况下编写推理轨迹。这样，教师模型不会自行定义 ground truth，但仍能产出与模型风格匹配的推理监督。

开源数据：有。名称：π² 训练数据与 π²-Bench。官方代码与项目：https://github.com/vt-pi-squared/pi-squared。官方数据：https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1ISRgLijDFvwFpHzV4tmHix6MIwIGG2gd?usp=sharing。规模：1,174 条已验证 QA 轨迹，其中 922 条用于训练；π²-Bench 含 228 条人工复核记录，划分为 178 条测试和 50 条验证。记录形式：长非结构化上下文、分析问题、结构化推理轨迹、短答案与构造元数据；仓库链接 JSONL 数据。构造使用 Wikipedia 表格与页面、每题约 10 篇网页搜索文章、SQL 与 Python 一致答案、质量评分以及匹配模型家族的反向生成。许可：未确认。预期用途：长上下文 SFT、自蒸馏与评测。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Collect structured sources. Input: high-view and recent Wikipedia pages. Operation: extract tables, follow relevant links, and filter table dimensions/content. Output: 2,834 qualified tables from 6,614 pages. Check: retain tables that support nontrivial relational queries rather than direct lookup only.
  2. Generate analytical QA. Input: one table and its metadata. Operation: Qwen3.5-35B expands context and writes a realistic multi-hop question plus SQL; LLM quality ratings check complexity, self-containedness, and naturalness, with up to three regeneration attempts. Output: a candidate question and executable query. Check: reject low-rated or ill-formed questions.
  3. Establish the answer twice. Input: candidate QA and table. Operation: execute the generated SQL and independently solve the same query in Python, then use consensus normalization. Output: a short verified answer. Check: keep the record only when SQL and Python agree.
  4. Build realistic long context. Input: the validated QA, Wikipedia pages, linked pages, and about ten web-search articles. Operation: compact documents to at most 96K tokens while preserving answer evidence and removing the original table from the teacher view. Output: unstructured multi-document context. Check: verify that all required evidence survives compaction.
  5. Back-translate traces and split. Input: context, question, and verified answer. Operation: use GPT-OSS-120B or Qwen3.5-35B according to the target student family to write a step-by-step solution; human review produces π²-Bench. Output: 1,174 QA traces, including 922 training examples and a 228-item benchmark. Check: keep training and benchmark disjoint and revise benchmark defects.
  6. Fine-tune. Input: 922 training records. Operation: LoRA rank-8 SFT for about one epoch/200 steps with maximum sequence length 128K. Output: π²-20B-A3B and π²-4B models. Check: compare the identical base models before/after SFT at fixed reasoning effort.

Reproducibility: official code, JSONL data, and models are linked. Pin Wikipedia/web snapshots, search results, table filters, Qwen/teacher versions, SQL/Python normalization, compaction policy, student-family mapping, and LoRA settings; data license remains unconfirmed.

1. 收集结构化来源。 输入：浏览量高且较新的 Wikipedia 页面。操作：提取表格、跟随相关链接，并按表格尺寸和内容过滤。输出：从 6,614 个页面得到 2,834 张合格表格。检查：只保留能支持非平凡关系查询、而不只是直接查值的表格。
  2. 生成分析 QA。 输入：一张表格及其元数据。操作：Qwen3.5-35B 扩展上下文，编写真实多跳问题和 SQL；LLM 质量评分检查复杂度、自包含性与自然性，最多重生成 3 次。输出：候选问题与可执行查询。检查：拒绝低评分或格式错误的问题。
  3. 独立确定两次答案。 输入：候选 QA 和表格。操作：执行生成的 SQL，并用 Python 独立求解相同查询，再规范化两边结果。输出：经过验证的短答案。检查：只有 SQL 与 Python 一致时才保留。
  4. 构建真实长上下文。 输入：已验证 QA、Wikipedia 页面、链接页面和约 10 篇网页搜索文章。操作：把文档压缩到最多 96K token，同时保留答案证据，并从教师模型输入中删除原表格。输出：非结构化多文档上下文。检查：确认压缩后仍含全部必要证据。
  5. 反向生成轨迹并划分。 输入：上下文、问题与已验证答案。操作：根据目标学生模型家族选择 GPT-OSS-120B 或 Qwen3.5-35B 编写逐步解法；人工复核形成 π²-Bench。输出：1,174 条 QA 轨迹，其中 922 条训练样本和 228 条 benchmark 记录。检查：训练与 benchmark 不重叠，并修订 benchmark 缺陷。
  6. 执行微调。 输入：922 条训练记录。操作：使用 LoRA rank 8 训练约 1 个 epoch 或 200 步，最大序列长度为 128K。输出：π²-20B-A3B 与 π²-4B 模型。检查：在固定 reasoning effort 下比较同一个 base model 的训练前后结果。

复现信息：官方代码、JSONL 数据与模型均有链接。需要固定 Wikipedia 与网页快照、搜索结果、表格过滤、Qwen 与教师模型版本、SQL/Python 结果规范化、压缩策略、学生家族映射和 LoRA 设置；数据许可仍未确认。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
Matched before/after SFT (Table 2). Across LongSeal, LongBenchV2, Oolong, OfficeQA, and π²-Bench, the same GPT-OSS-20B base rises from 37.95 to 42.23 average under low reasoning effort and from 48.90 to 53.22 under high effort after LoRA on 922 records. Model, benchmark suite, and inference effort are controlled within each pair, supporting transfer from a small curated set.

Data-efficiency check (Table 3). Training the same model on only the 100 records with the highest combined quality ratings still raises the low-effort average from 37.95 to 39.29 and the high-effort average from 48.90 to 51.75. The smaller gains than the full set support both record quality and additional coverage from scaling to 922 examples.

匹配训练前后对比，表 2。 在 LongSeal、LongBenchV2、Oolong、OfficeQA 与 π²-Bench 上，同一个 GPT-OSS-20B base 在 low reasoning effort 下由平均 37.95 提高到 42.23，在 high reasoning effort 下由 48.90 提高到 53.22；训练只使用 922 条记录的 LoRA。每组内部模型、benchmark 集合和推理强度一致，因此支持小规模整理数据具有迁移效果。

数据效率检查，表 3。 只用综合质量评分最高的 100 条记录训练同一模型，low effort 平均分仍由 37.95 提高到 39.29，high effort 由 48.90 提高到 51.75。提升小于完整数据集，说明高质量单条记录有效，同时扩大到 922 条还带来额外覆盖。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Existing long-context QA generators usually create questions directly from documents or keep structured tables visible in the final context. π² uses table structure only to originate and independently verify the QA, then asks the student to solve the same task over realistic unstructured documents. Teacher traces are back-translated from verified answers without access to the hidden table. The novelty is this structure-originated, dual-execution data contract rather than web search or SFT alone.
已有长上下文 QA 生成器通常直接从文档生成问题，或让结构化表格继续出现在最终上下文。π² 只用表格结构发起并独立验证 QA，再让学生模型在真实非结构化文档中解决同一任务；教师轨迹根据已验证答案反向生成，且看不到隐藏表格。新意在于这种结构发起、双重执行的数据契约，而不是网页搜索或 SFT 本身。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
• About 17% of initially selected benchmark candidates required human revision, so SQL/Python agreement does not guarantee natural, unambiguous QA.
  • Experiments cover context-provided QA up to 128K and small-model LoRA, not million-token retrieval, free-form synthesis, or other long-context capabilities.
  • Web/Wikipedia snapshots, source rights, and the released dataset license are not fully specified; answer verification does not resolve provenance or temporal drift.

• 最初入选的 benchmark 候选中约 17% 需要人工修订，因此 SQL 与 Python 一致不能保证 QA 自然且无歧义。
  • 实验只覆盖最长 128K 的上下文内 QA 与小模型 LoRA，没有检验百万 token 检索、自由形式综合或其它长上下文能力。
  • 网页与 Wikipedia 快照、来源权利和发布数据许可未完整说明；答案验证也不能解决溯源或时间漂移问题。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
• Use π² to generate long-context QA when structured tables can define ground truth but deployment inputs should look like ordinary documents.
  • Keep independent SQL/Python solvers and evidence-retention checks separate from teacher trace generation; never let the teacher define the answer.
  • Before reuse, pin web snapshots, audit rights and license, verify train/evaluation lineage, and manually sample for ambiguity after compaction.

• 当结构化表格可以定义 ground truth、但部署输入应呈现为普通文档时，可用 π² 生成长上下文 QA。
  • 应把独立 SQL/Python 求解器和证据保留检查与教师轨迹生成分开，不能让教师模型定义答案。
  • 复用前应固定网页快照、审计权利与许可、核查训练评测来源链，并在压缩后人工抽查歧义。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Position: derive reliable long-context QA from structure while training on realistic unstructured evidence.
  • Method handle: table selection, QA/SQL generation, independent Python agreement, web-context compaction, trace back-translation.
  • Data/artifact handle: 1,174 validated traces, 922 training records, and a 228-item benchmark; official code and JSONL links exist.
  • Evidence anchor: GPT-OSS-20B averages improve 37.95 to 42.23 at low effort and 48.90 to 53.22 at high effort.
  • Reuse decision: useful for multi-document analytical QA after source, license, evidence-retention, and ambiguity audits.

• 一句话定位： 从结构获得可靠长上下文 QA，但在真实非结构化证据上训练。
  • 方法抓手： 表格筛选、QA 与 SQL 生成、独立 Python 一致判断、网页上下文压缩、轨迹反向生成。
  • 数据与产物抓手： 1,174 条已验证轨迹、922 条训练记录和 228 条 benchmark；已有官方代码与 JSONL 链接。
  • 证据锚点： GPT-OSS-20B 在 low effort 下平均分由 37.95 提高到 42.23，在 high effort 下由 48.90 提高到 53.22。
  • 复用决定： 适合多文档分析 QA，但需要审计来源、许可、证据保留与问题歧义。
